messages:
sam: Heads-up: our samplekit onboarding run produced duplicate external side-effects. Root cause looks like a race between token refresh retries and the original request.

julia: yikes. can you drop the minimal repro/logs? :eyes: 

sam: repro flow and a tiny log snippet below. basically: client detects 401 -> starts token refresh -> auth mock returns 429 -> client immediately retries request -> webhook gets called twice.

log: 
```
2026-03-22T14:02:10Z INFO samplekit req=id_42 status=401 refresh:start
2026-03-22T14:02:11Z WARN oauth refresh id=42 result=429 rate_limited
2026-03-22T14:02:11Z INFO samplekit retry attempt=1 req=id_42
2026-03-22T14:02:11Z INFO webhook send req=id_42 status=200
2026-03-22T14:02:12Z INFO samplekit retry attempt=2 req=id_42
2026-03-22T14:02:12Z INFO webhook send req=id_42 status=200
```

ben: so two things: (A) no jitter/backoff on the auth retry, and (B) no idempotency header on the outgoing webhook. both together amplify the duplicate side-effect.

maria: samplekit default retry is linear: backoff_ms = attempt * 500. no jitter option exposed in SDK config. webhook client doesn't attach Idempotency-Key because we treated webhooks as "fire-and-forget" until now.

sam: proposal: 1) add full jitter per attempt on auth refresh; 2) middleware that injects Idempotency-Key for webhook sends if payload.operation_id exists; 3) add a test harness that simulates 429 during refresh and asserts at-most-once semantics per operation_id.

julia: agree. full jitter is what we recommend in docs anyway. small note: use exponential base 100ms and full jitter formula from AWS: sleep = rand(0, base * 2**attempt).

ben: implementation detail: SDK retry config currently: {retries, baseMs}. we can add jitter: ["none","fixed","full"] defaulting to full for new samplekit versions but keep default for legacy builds to avoid surprises.

maria: I can add the enum and implement full jitter in the Node client tomorrow. will also emit a metric samplekit.retry.on_refresh_count.

sam: I'll own the idempotency middleware. simple behavior: if no Idempotency-Key present and payload.operation_id exists, set header to payload.operation_id. opt-out via headers.allow_dup=true for tests. code sketch: 
```
if (!headers['Idempotency-Key'] && payload.operation_id) {
  headers['Idempotency-Key'] = payload.operation_id
}
```

ben: also add a diagnostic metric that counts duplicate sends within a short window: samplekit.duplicate_send_detected when same operation_id hits webhook within 5s. useful for postmortems.

qa-bot: suggested test: run race harness 2000 iterations with artificial 429 on first refresh attempt and assert webhook endpoint receives <=1 call per operation_id. include flaky-run stats.

maria: noted. PR plan: 
- SDK: add jitter enum + full jitter impl + metric (PR tomorrow)
- samplekit: add idempotency middleware + e2e harness + README blurb (sam will PR)
- QA: run harness and share results here, fail fast on duplicates >0 per 10k runs.

sam: quick curl repro I'll paste into PR: 
```
# repro (local)
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/run -H "Authorization: Bearer expired" -d '{"operation_id":"op-789"}'
# make auth mock return 429 on first refresh attempt
```

julia: long-term: recommend we update onboarding docs and the quickstart sample to include idempotency-by-default for outgoing side-effects and document the jitter default. this will cut down support noise.

ben: extra thought: for Redwood Dedicated customers we could offer a server-side dedupe service they can opt into to simplify SDK logic. not required for this fix.

maria: assigning tasks in GH: I'll pick SDK jitter, sam picks middleware + harness. QA will run harness after both PRs merged.

sam: will post PR links when ready. thanks all. :white_check_mark: 

julia: closing once QA harness passes and README updated. :thumbsup:
